audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and the full-layer phase sides contradicted their own whys: whys[1] argues Gnar owns level 2 and whys[4] argues level 6 is his window, but both were marked otherwise, and level 1 was 'Skill' while whys[0] says you win it.
audit.why: Cannon Q out-ranges Boomerang Throw at level 1 with no Hop yet; at 2 his second Q point plus Hop kites your step-up before Acceleration Gate exists; at 6 a full Rage bar gives GNAR! into Wallop.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Gnar, Jayce, Skill, Gnar, Jayce, Jayce.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer treats level 6 as a GNAR! cooldown spike; Jayce has no level-6 spike at all and Gnar's is not a level.
audit.why: Jayce's R is the stance-swap he already had. Gnar's spike is the Rage bar filling, which is combat-driven, not a level or a cooldown.
audit.corrected: Spikes are now Rage-bar-driven for him and Acceleration Gate / Eclipse for you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer line said to track a 'GNAR! cooldown', and mini Gnar's escape was never named.
audit.why: GNAR! is only castable in Mega form, so the gate is the Rage bar, not the 90/60/30s cooldown. Mini Gnar's only dodge is Hop (E) at 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s — with it spent, an accelerated Shock Blast is unavoidable.
audit.corrected: Track the Rage bar; punish spent Hop with gate-Q; hold Thundering Blow for the transform.

audit.why: Hop 22s at rank 1 and Wallop 7s are the two timers that decide when you can walk up.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns and the Key Ability Interactions block.

edits.before: Poke mini — E-knock Mega, win the poke war. Jayce wins the GNAR! cooldown windows.
edits.after: Poke mini — E-knock Mega, win the poke war. Watch the Rage bar, not a GNAR! cooldown.

edits.before: Poke mini and knock Mega away. Track GNAR! before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Poke mini and knock Mega away. Track his Rage bar before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Cannon Q-poke wins range wars before minions even matter. Identify how Gnar contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Cannon Q out-ranges Boomerang Throw and mini Gnar has no dash yet at level 1 — land the orb on every last-hit step he takes.

edits.before: The gate turns poke into artillery. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: His level 2 is stronger: a second boomerang point plus Hop kites your step-up.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gnar's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R is only the stance-swap you already had; a full Rage bar gives him GNAR! into Wallop, and a wall doubles the stun.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. E-knock it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - GNAR!: 90s at rank 1, but the real gate is his Rage bar — it fills in combat and drains out of it. - Hop (E): 22s at rank 1, his only dodge; gate-Q the moment it is spent. - Wallop: 7s.

edits.before: Trade strictly around GNAR!: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around his Rage bar: poke while it drains, give nothing once it is near full. If ahead, freeze and starve him.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! before you commit
edits.after: Track Gnar's Rage bar before you commit

edits.before: His Mega all-in. E-knock it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Mega is Rage-gated, not cooldown-gated — poke while the bar bleeds down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mega out-stats you — hold Thundering Blow for the moment he transforms.

edits.before: No permanent owner here — the level chart shows where momentum tilts and tilts back.
edits.after: You own 1 and 3, he owns 2 and 6 — the chart shows exactly where it tilts back.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. E-knock it. When it is down — Cannon-Q + hammer him.
edits.after: Mini Gnar's only dodge is Hop (E), 22s at rank 1 — fire your gate-Q the moment he spends it.

notes: win[1]/win[4] and phases[1]/[4].side change 'Jayce'/'Skill' to 'Gnar' — these are enum side fields, not prose, so the +/-10% length band should not be applied to them.
